title: MalisisSwitchesReborn
body:
MalisisSwitchesReborn is an unofficial modern-day re-imagination of the classic [MalisisSwitches](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/malisisswitches) mod by [Ordinastie](https://www.curseforge.com/members/ordinastie/projects) from the Minecraft 1.12 era, bringing its simple and flexible redstone control blocks to newer Minecraft versions.

MalisisSwitchesReborn focuses on preserving the original spirit, look, and feel as much as possible while rebuilding the experience around modern Minecraft systems. No external core libraries are required.

Note: The Player Sensor is inspired by similar functionality from the original MalisisBlocks mod.

### Latest Update - Version 1.0.3

MalisisSwitchesReborn 1.0.3 includes refreshed textures and an updated relay that now displays the current redstone power level on its screen.

### Features

*   Switch — A compact wall-mounted switch that can also control the redstone current from a distance
*   Light Switch — Another simple switch that can also control the redstone current from a distance
*   Player Sensor — A simple sensor that activates based on player proximity and can also control the redstone current from a distance
*   Relay — Receives power from linked switches and outputs standard redstone
*   Power Linker — Connect switches and relays to compatible blocks wirelessly
*   Greenstone — Green dust that comes from redstone with a bit of emerald. Makes the redstone wireless

### How It Works

Switches and sensors work like vanilla levers, and can be linked to other blocks using the Power Linker tool. Firstly, equip the Power Linker, right-click a switch/sensor, and then right-click blocks you want the redstone current to be applied to. You can also unlink by sneak right-clicking a previously linked block.

Right-clicking another switch/sensor will set that switch/sensor as the source and unequipping the Power Linker clears the current source also.

Relays can be linked to switches, sensors, and other relays in the same way. Relays output a standard redstone signal and can be used with:

*   Redstone dust
*   Repeaters & Comparators
*   Pistons
*   Doors
*   Any vanilla or modded block that accepts a redstone signal

By equipping the Power Linker a player is also able to see the links (powered = green; unpowered = red) between switches/sensors/relays and linked locations.

### Reporting Issues

If you encounter a compatibility issue with another mod, or find a machine setup that behaves incorrectly, please report it via the [project issue tracker](https://github.com/pcolb1/MalisisSwitchesReborn/issues) so it can be investigated.
